messages.次のターンの攻撃威力増加とクイックを稼ぎ、雑魚戦で他の味方の撃破によるバフも重ね: A starting Envy Blunt E.G.O that earns Attack Power Up and Haste for the next turn and, in fights against weak enemies, also stacks buffs from allies' kills.
messages.次ターンのバフ獲得: 的中時に次のターンの攻撃威力増加1とクイック3を得る(解析: **Next-turn buffs**: On hit, he gains 1 Attack Power Up and 3 Haste next turn (Threadspin Ⅲ and up).
messages.パッシブ「傲気」: 他の味方が敵を倒すと、次のターン開始時に攻撃威力増加1・クイ: **Passive — Vying Spirit**: When another ally defeats an enemy, he gains 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Haste at the start of the next turn, up to 3. It is strong against many easy-to-kill enemies, and it does not apply on the turn it is used.
messages.撃破ボーナス(解析Ⅳ): 敵を倒すと次のターンの攻撃威力増加がさらに2付く。: **Kill bonus (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Defeating an enemy grants 2 more Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.侵蝕なし: 初期E.G.Oなので侵蝕スキルは無い。: **No Corrosion**: As a starting E.G.O, it has no Corrosion skill.
messages.長引きそうな雑魚戦では最初に使い、「傲気」を早く有効にする。: In fights against weak enemies that are likely to drag on, use it first to activate Vying Spirit early.
messages.強い攻撃の直前のターンに使うと、次のターンのバフを本命のスキルに乗せられる。: Using it on the turn before a strong attack lets the next turn's buffs ride on the skill that matters.
messages.耐性は色欲・暴食が脆弱、嫉妬が抵抗。嫉妬の攻撃には強いが、色欲・暴食の攻撃が多い: Its resistances are Fatal to Lust and Gluttony and Endured against Envy. It is strong against Envy attacks, but likely at a disadvantage in fights with many Lust or Gluttony attacks.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、バフ獲得が表面的中時から的中時に緩和され、クイックが2から3: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, relaxes the buff gain from Heads Hit to on hit, and raises Haste from 2 to 3.
messages.Ⅳ: 敵討伐時の攻撃威力増加2が加わる。火力が特別高いわけではないので、優先度は: **Ⅳ**: Adds 2 Attack Power Up on defeating an enemy. Its damage is not especially high, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.R社第4群ウサギチーム: S3が嫉妬の資源を出せ、速度6以上でコイン威力が上がる: **[R Corp. 4th Pack Rabbit](persona:0703)**: His S3 supplies Envy, and many of his skills gain Coin Power at 6 or more Speed, making Haste easy to use.
messages.LCB囚人: S1が嫉妬、S3が色欲の資源を出せるので、必要資源(色欲2・嫉妬2: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0701)**: His S1 supplies Envy and S3 supplies Lust, covering the required resources (2 Lust, 2 Envy) by himself.
